desc.testo: Kenvue Inc. is an American consumer health company. Formerly the Consumer Healthcare division of Johnson & Johnson, Kenvue owns well-known brands such as Aveeno, Band-Aid, Benadryl, Zyrtec, Johnson's, Listerine, Lactaid, Mylanta, Neutrogena, Trosyd, Calpol, Tylenol, and Visine.
desc.trad: Kenvue Inc. è un'azienda americana di prodotti per la salute dei consumatori. Ex divisione Consumer Healthcare di Johnson & Johnson, Kenvue possiede marchi noti come Aveeno, Band-Aid, Benadryl, Zyrtec, Johnson's, Listerine, Lactaid, Mylanta, Neutrogena, Trosyd, Calpol, Tylenol e Visine.
